title: VintaThemeManifest
description: Manifest definition for Vinta desktop themes (.vintatheme packages or theme directories).

$schema.description: Path or URI to the JSON Schema.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Default is 1. Bump only when breaking token removals or structural manifest shifts occur.

id.description: Unique identifier for theme. Lowercase alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore only.

name.description: Human readable name of the theme.

version.description: Semantic versioning string for the theme.

entry.description: Path to entry stylesheet relative to theme root. Usually style.css.

preview.description: Optional relative path to a preview thumbnail image (PNG/WebP/SVG).

accentColor.description: Hex or CSS color string used as accent preview pill in UI selectors.

meta.description: Optional metadata dictionary for theme creator notes or repository links.
